email.subject: FNOL Notice - Riverside Manufacturing Co. / Policy SBA-4471902
email.body:
Karen,

Please treat this as first notice of loss for Riverside Manufacturing Co. under policy SBA-4471902 with The Hartford.

We are reporting a new claim involving damage that occurred on the insured premises at 2200 Foundry Road, Cleveland, OH 44115. Please confirm claim setup and advise the claim number, assigned adjuster, and any documentation needed to support the loss.

If you need a requested loss date or additional incident details, reply and we will provide them immediately.

Thank you,
Great Lakes Insurance Advisors
